response.sql:
WITH playlist_counts AS (
  SELECT p.PlaylistId, COUNT(pt.TrackId) AS track_count
  FROM Playlist AS p
  LEFT JOIN PlaylistTrack AS pt ON pt.PlaylistId = p.PlaylistId
  GROUP BY p.PlaylistId
), average_count AS (
  SELECT AVG(track_count) AS avg_track_count
  FROM playlist_counts
)
SELECT pc.PlaylistId,
       pc.track_count,
       1.0 * pc.track_count / NULLIF(ac.avg_track_count, 0) AS ratio
FROM playlist_counts AS pc
CROSS JOIN average_count AS ac
ORDER BY ratio DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: The average is across all playlists, including playlists with no tracks; each playlist counts once.
